question: What fire offering is prescribed using ten thousand sticks of the royal tree?
premises: Ten thousand is the specified quantity.
Fuel sticks come from the royal tree.
inference: One who offers ten thousand fuel sticks of the royal tree performs the prescribed oblation.
uncertainties: The exact species intended by rāja+vṛkṣa is not specified.
plain_english: But whoever should offer ten thousand fuel sticks of the royal tree in the fire.
